patch.value: Stream ordinary large-file staging into native CDC manifests

Connect vcs add to bounded CDC for non-record regular files at least 1 MiB, preserve FileIds across moves and PM attribution, keep status bounded for manifest-backed files, and publish reproducible scale and GC byte receipts.

Native add and status handle large binary files without whole-file buffers; rename plus edit retains FileId and PM change trace; compression-independent identities and range verification pass; GC reports physical candidate and reclaimed bytes; report a 200 MB binary and real tracker copy measurement.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Behavioural revert proof: restoring only stageLocked makes native staging streams CDC fail because no binary is staged; restoring only computeStatus fails on the forbidden whole-file reader; restoring only collectGarbage fails the physical-byte receipt assertions. Each mutation was tested in an isolated source copy. Initial 200 MB measurement exposed excessive fsynced loose-object overhead with fine-grained CDC, so ordinary large staging now uses 64 KiB minimum, 1 MiB maximum and an 18-bit Gear mask while existing helper defaults remain unchanged. The partial benchmark scratch copy was removed before remeasurement.
